items.source: Create a new ExtractingResponseErrorHandler with the given HttpMessageConverter instances.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有给定HttpMessageConverter实例的ExtractingResponseErrorHandler。

items.source: To use this error handler, you must specify a status mapping and/or a series mapping. If either of these mappings has a match for the status code of a given ClientHttpResponse, DefaultResponseErrorHandler.hasError(ClientHttpResponse) will return true, and handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod) will attempt to use the configured message converters to convert the response into the mapped subclass of RestClientException. Note that the status mapping takes precedence over series mapping.
items.translation: 要使用此错误处理器，必须指定一个 状态映射 和/或一个 系列映射。如果这些映射中的任何一个与给定 ClientHttpResponse 的 状态码 匹配，则 DefaultResponseErrorHandler.hasError(ClientHttpResponse) 将返回 true，并且 handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod) 将尝试使用配置的 消息转换器 将响应转换为 RestClientException 的映射子类。请注意，状态映射 优先于 系列映射。

items.source: If there is no match, this error handler will default to the behavior of DefaultResponseErrorHandler. Note that you can override this default behavior by specifying a series mapping from HttpStatus.Series#CLIENT_ERROR and/or HttpStatus.Series#SERVER_ERROR to null.
items.translation: 如果没有匹配项，此错误处理程序将默认采用DefaultResponseErrorHandler的行为。请注意，您可以通过指定从HttpStatus.Series#CLIENT_ERROR和/或HttpStatus.Series#SERVER_ERROR到null的系列映射来覆盖此默认行为。

items.source: Note that setMessageConverters(List) must be called when using this constructor.
items.translation: 注意，在使用此构造函数时，必须调用setMessageConverters(List)。

items.source: Set the mapping from HTTP status code to RestClientException subclass. If this mapping has a match for the status code of a given ClientHttpResponse, DefaultResponseErrorHandler.hasError(ClientHttpResponse) will return true and handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod) will attempt to use the configured message converters to convert the response into the mapped subclass of RestClientException.
items.translation: 设置从 HTTP 状态码到 `RestClientException` 子类的映射。如果此映射与给定 `ClientHttpResponse` 的 状态码 匹配，则 DefaultResponseErrorHandler.hasError(ClientHttpResponse) 将返回 `true`，并且 handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod) 将尝试使用配置的 消息转换器 将响应转换为映射的 `RestClientException` 子类。

items.source: Set the mapping from HTTP status series to RestClientException subclass. If this mapping has a match for the status code of a given ClientHttpResponse, DefaultResponseErrorHandler.hasError(ClientHttpResponse) will return true and handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod) will attempt to use the configured message converters to convert the response into the mapped subclass of RestClientException.
items.translation: 设置从 HTTP 状态系列到 `RestClientException` 子类的映射。如果此映射与给定 ClientHttpResponse 的状态码匹配，则 DefaultResponseErrorHandler.hasError(ClientHttpResponse)将返回true，并且 handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod) 将尝试使用配置的转换器将响应转换为映射的 RestClientException子类。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to HttpClientErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset) for errors in the 4xx range, to HttpServerErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset) for errors in the 5xx range, or otherwise raises UnknownHttpStatusCodeException.
items.translation: 默认实现会针对 4xx 范围的错误委托给HttpClientErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)，针对 5xx 范围的错误委托给HttpServerErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)，否则抛出UnknownHttpStatusCodeException。

items.source: The default implementation checks HttpStatusCode.isError(). Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现检查HttpStatusCode.isError()。可在子类中重写。
